area: focus and keys on the board
situation: Start at the board address #/ with the default data and let the clock run 2200 ms, so that every column has loaded.
Put focus on card SL-119 (the second card of In progress) and press ArrowRight.
question: Which card has focus now?
answer: SL-121 Design label colours, the second card of Done. The empty Review column is skipped.
